facts.text: Minimum 25 % consistency score to qualify for a withdrawal (20 % on Instant Plus).
facts.excerpt: Your first payout is on demand. You must complete a minimum of 10 trading days before requesting a withdrawal. Traders must maintain a minimum 25% consistency score (20% consistency for Instant Plus) to qualify for a withdrawal. Payouts can be requested every 14 days (bi-weekly) thereafter. Instant accounts follow a bi-weekly payout schedule, meaning payouts can be requested every 14 days.
